title: VIXEN build witness must survive elastic queue resize and IO-pressure head stalls
body: The documented queued full product build (bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent cx-edmat12 --resource build --label cx-edmat12:wave-product-build -- bash -lc 'cmake --build build/wsl-debug') was admitted but the live wrapper elastic resize called box-queue-core with unexpected argument true and exited 2; a fresh retry then stalled at head_blocked_io-pressure_114s_budget_spent and was terminated. The narrower queued target cmake --build build/wsl-debug --target vixen_editor succeeded once the queue recovered. The queue/build pipeline should fail early with a located diagnostic or make elastic resize and IO-pressure backoff transparent/reliable for admitted product builds. Tier luna: cross-tool queue/runtime behavior needs diagnosis; effort M.

title: Paired Undertow author build needs manual private-kernel API feed provisioning
body: The queued author CLI build failed before compilation because the paired checkout had no pinned kernel API feed; the documented workaround was a separate queued `YEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy/.claude-worktrees/edjoin1 bash tools/provider-root.sh kernel --ensure`, followed by the build. A paired private-kernel build should provision or validate its feed as part of the normal author witness.

title: Windowed material probes need a bounded procedural-frame settle
body: The 1920x1080 GPU witness reached the rendered two-material frame but appflow.material_probe raced the procedural HitRecord hand-off; the harness needed an explicit five-frame await before scanning. The facade/capture service should expose or await the producer-ready boundary.

title: Windowed VIXEN AppFlow witnesses need DISPLAY provisioning
body: The first direct default-material capture exited 255 before AppFlow because DISPLAY was unset; the queued GPU payload only worked after explicit DISPLAY=:0 and VK_ICD_FILENAMES provisioning. The capture service should provision or validate the window/display environment in its queued producer.

title: RenderGraph UI guard must run from its staged asset working directory
body: The named PanelDockDocuments guard failed from the repository cwd with assets/ui/*.rml missing and exited 139; rerunning from the current staged vixen_assets bundle directory passed all 8 tests. CMake/CTest should provide the target working directory or an absolute asset root automatically.
